vehicleDetails.title: Rizta Z Pro
vehicleDetails.description:
The Ather Rizta Z Pro series is designed to redefine the family electric scooter segment, prioritizing space, comfort, and intelligent convenience. Built on a platform that emphasizes a wide, ergonomic seat and a low center of gravity, this series delivers a stable and luxurious riding experience for both the rider and the pillion. By integrating Ather’s proven electric powertrain with the premium "Pro" software suite, the Rizta Z Pro ensures that your family journeys are safe, comfortable, and deeply connected.

The Ather Rizta Z Pro Lineup

The series offers two specialized configurations, each optimized to provide a unique balance of endurance and power for your daily needs.

Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh)

The 2.9 kWh variant is the ideal solution for frequent, shorter-distance city commuting, offering a perfect blend of agility and efficiency.

  • Battery Capacity: 2.9 kWh
  • Certified Range (IDC): 123 km
  • Top Speed: 80 km/h

Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh)

The 3.7 kWh variant serves as the endurance flagship, designed for families who require extended range for longer commutes and inter-city travel.

  • Battery Capacity: 3.7 kWh
  • Certified Range (IDC): 159 km
  • Top Speed: 80 km/h

Advanced Engineering & Connectivity

The Ather Rizta Z Pro series is engineered to provide a premium, feature-rich experience for every family journey:

  • Comfort-First Architecture: Featuring a class-leading 900mm long seat, the series is designed to accommodate two adults comfortably and includes a dedicated pillion backrest. The chassis is optimized for stability, ensuring a planted and smooth ride.
  • Smart "Pro" Interface: The series features a vibrant, 7-inch TFT touchscreen display. With the Pro package, riders benefit from Google Maps navigation, smartphone connectivity, music controls, and real-time ride analytics, all integrated seamlessly into the dashboard.
  • Safety & Convenience: The Rizta Z Pro is equipped with advanced safety tech, including AutoHold™ for inclines, FallSafe™ to cut power in the event of a tip-over, and SkidControl™ for superior traction on varying road surfaces. It also includes "Magic Twist™" for regenerative braking and an ample 34-liter boot for total practicality.
  • Secure Connectivity: With the Ather App, users get access to live vehicle status, remote charging tracking, and theft/tow alerts, ensuring your vehicle is always protected and ready to go.

Why Choose the Ather Rizta Z Pro Series?

The Ather Rizta Z Pro series is the definitive choice for families who refuse to compromise on comfort or smart technology. By combining a wide, ergonomic design with an advanced software suite and reliable electric range, these scooters make every family errand or commute effortless and enjoyable. Whether you prioritize the agile 2.9 kWh variant or the unparalleled endurance of the 3.7 kWh flagship, the Rizta Z Pro delivers an unmatched blend of safety, space, and essential smart features on every journey.

variantData.title: Rizta Z Pro - 2.9 kWh
variantData.description:
The Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) is the ultimate uncompromised smart scooter for the tech-savvy urban family. It takes the premium comfort and striking TFT touchscreen of the "Z" variant and fully unleashes its digital capabilities via the integrated Pro Pack. Designed for families who want the absolute best in navigation, safety, and smartphone connectivity without carrying a massive, heavy battery pack for short city commutes, this is the perfect harmony of luxury and daily practicality.

Key Performance & Unlocked "Pro" Features

  • Fully Connected Touchscreen: The Pro Pack brings the vibrant 7-inch TFT Touchscreen to its full potential. It unlocks built-in Google Maps for seamless Turn-by-Turn navigation, Bluetooth connectivity for call and music controls, WhatsApp notifications, and advanced real-time ride telemetry synced to your phone.
  • Ultimate Safety Suite: Carrying family requires maximum safety, and the Pro upgrade unlocks Ather's exclusive SkidControl™ (advanced traction control preventing wheel slip), AutoHold™ (hill assist for steep inclines), and FallSafe™ technology.
  • City-Optimized Range: Powered by the lighter, highly efficient 2.9 kWh Lithium-ion battery, it delivers a highly reliable 123 km IDC range, providing the exact right amount of energy for daily office commutes, school drops, and localized errands.
  • Smooth Performance: It utilizes a 4.3 kW PMSM motor to reach a safe, comfortable top speed of 80 km/h. The Pro Pack unlocks dynamic riding modes, including the punchier Zip mode, to help you navigate city traffic effortlessly.
  • Premium Comfort: It retains the luxurious Z-trim physical features: a class-leading 900mm long seat, a dedicated pillion backrest for passenger comfort, and a cavernous 34-liter under-seat boot.

Variant Comparison: The "Pro" Advantage in the City

The Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) sits at the intersection of premium cabin technology and localized urban range. Here is how it compares to the rest of the Rizta family to help you make your final choice.

1. Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh): The Software Unlock

This is the most direct comparison: the standard model versus the fully unlocked model.

  • Hardware Parity: Both scooters are physically identical, sharing the 2.9 kWh battery (123 km range), the pillion backrest, and the physical TFT touchscreen.
  • The "Pro" Difference: The standard Ather Rizta Z (2.9 kWh) gives you the premium screen but limits software features. The Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) unlocks the screen's full potential—giving you integrated Google Maps, Bluetooth controls, SkidControl™, and the highly convenient AutoHold™.
  • Verdict: If you just want the aesthetic of the premium touchscreen, the standard Rizta Z is fine. If you want that screen to act like a smart device that guides you through traffic and actively prevents skidding, the Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) is the mandatory upgrade.

2. Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh): The Range Extension

If you know you want all the Pro software and the premium touchscreen, your decision comes down entirely to battery size.

  • Identical Experience: Both scooters feature the fully unlocked TFT touchscreen, SkidControl™, AutoHold™, and the passenger backrest.
  • The Endurance Gap: The Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) delivers a 123 km IDC range, which is perfect (and lighter) for localized city riding. The Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) utilizes the flagship battery pack to push that range up to an expansive 159 km IDC.
  • Verdict: If your daily travel is short and highly predictable, the 2.9 kWh variant saves you money while delivering the exact same tech experience. If you travel inter-city or want maximum peace of mind between charges, the 3.7 kWh variant is the necessary upgrade.

3. Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) VS Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh): Display & Pillion Comfort

This comparison determines whether you prefer tactile switches or a premium touchscreen cabin for your smart features.

  • Shared Tech & Range: Both models utilize the 2.9 kWh battery (123 km range) and offer smart Pro features like navigation and AutoHold™.
  • The "Z" Factor: The Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) uses the physical DeepView™ LCD screen and a standard long seat. The Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) upgrades the experience to a full-color TFT Touchscreen (adding Google Maps and SkidControl™) and includes a dedicated pillion backrest.
  • Verdict: Choose the S Pro if you want smart features on a durable, glare-free physical display. Upgrade to the Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) if you want a smartphone-like interactive screen, advanced traction control, and back support for your passenger.

Why Choose the Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh)?

The Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) is the ultimate "no-compromises" machine for the dedicated city family. It provides the absolute highest level of technology Ather offers—Google Maps, SkidControl™, and Bluetooth connectivity—without forcing you to carry a larger, more expensive battery you simply might not need for your daily 15 km commute. It is premium, incredibly smart, and perfectly balanced for the urban jungle.

variantData.title: Rizta Z Pro - 3.7 kWh
variantData.description:
The Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) is the ultimate, no-compromise expression of Ather's family scooter. This top-tier variant takes the massive battery and premium hardware of the "Z" trim and completely unlocks its software capabilities through the integrated Pro Pack. Designed for families who want the longest possible driving range combined with the full suite of connected smart features, the Rizta Z Pro ensures that every commute is as entertaining and connected as it is safe and comfortable.

Key Performance & Unlocked "Pro" Features

  • Maximum Driving Range : Equipped with Ather’s largest 3.7 kWh Lithium-ion battery, this variant offers a stress-free IDC range of 159 km. It handles days of school drops, office commutes, and grocery runs on a single charge.
  • Pro Pack Connectivity : The Pro Pack fully unlocks the stunning 7-inch TFT Touchscreen. It brings the dashboard to life with full Google Maps integration, Bluetooth call/music controls, WhatsApp notifications, and advanced ride statistics right at your fingertips.
  • Advanced Ride Modes : Upgrading to the Pro unlocks Ather's intelligent riding modes, giving you access to SmartEco, Eco, Ride, and Zip modes, allowing you to seamlessly switch between maximum battery efficiency and punchy, 80 km/h performance.
  • Unmatched Safety Suite : The Pro package unlocks advanced rider aids like SkidControl™ (preventing loss of traction on slippery roads), FallSafe™ (cutting the motor if the scooter tips over), and the highly convenient AutoHold™ for effortless stops on inclines.
  • Family-First Comfort : It retains the Rizta's hallmark physical features: a massive 900mm long seat, a comfortable pillion backrest, and a cavernous 34-liter boot space for all your cargo needs.

Why Choose the Z Pro?

The Ather Rizta lineup is highly customizable. Here is how the fully-loaded Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) stands out against the rest of the family.

1. Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) VS. Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh): The "Pro" Software Advantage

If you are deciding between the standard Z and the Z Pro, it comes down entirely to smart technology.

  • Identical Hardware: Both scooters feature the exact same 3.7 kWh battery, 159 km range, and TFT physical dashboard.
  • The "Pro" Unlock: The standard Ather Rizta Z (3.7 kWh) offers basic riding modes and standard navigation. The Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) unlocks the true potential of the scooter, giving you Google Maps, AutoHold™, SkidControl™, advanced ride stats, and the sporty "Zip" mode.
  • Verdict: Choose the standard Z if you only care about physical range and comfort. Choose the Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) if you want the full "smart scooter" experience with advanced safety and connectivity.

2. Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) VS. Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh): The Range Upgrade

This comparison is for buyers who know they want the "Pro" tech but are debating battery size.

  • Shared Tech: Both models feature the fully unlocked TFT Touchscreen, SkidControl™, and all connected Pro Pack features.
  • The Endurance Gap: The Ather Rizta Z Pro (2.9 kWh) uses a smaller battery that delivers a 123 km IDC range. The Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) utilizes the flagship battery, pushing that range to a massive 159 km.
  • Verdict: The 2.9 kWh Pro is excellent for standard city use. However, if your family commutes are longer, or you want the peace of mind of less frequent charging, the Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) is the definitive upgrade.

3. Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) VS. Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh): The Ultimate Step-Up

Comparing the entry-level Pro to the flagship Pro highlights the full spectrum of the Rizta family.

  • Display Technology: The Ather Rizta S Pro (2.9 kWh) uses the simpler DeepView™ LCD display. The Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) offers the vibrant, full-color TFT Touchscreen.
  • Battery & Range: The S Pro is limited to the smaller 2.9 kWh battery (123 km range), while the Z Pro utilizes the massive 3.7 kWh pack (159 km range).
  • Verdict: The S Pro is the budget-friendly way to get Pro features. But for the absolute best display, best range, and most premium experience Ather offers, the Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) is the ultimate destination.

Why Choose the Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh)?

The Ather Rizta Z Pro (3.7 kWh) is for the buyer who wants it all. It is the only variant that combines the physical endurance of the 159 km battery with the software brilliance of the unlocked Pro Pack. It ensures that your family travels with the utmost space and comfort, guarded by the best traction control systems, and guided by integrated Google Maps. It is the benchmark for the modern family EV.
